governing_principle: Calibrate real hierarchical nuisance geometry without changing the frozen stress simulator topology or nuisance-family logic.

frozen_topology.rule: N_DISTAL=24 and N_LINKED_PER_PROM=4 remain unchanged in this geometry-only qualification. Real promoter degree is a nuisance covariate, NOT the number of synthetic candidate slots.

promoter_level.definition: One value per real promoter anchor. promoter_degree is the number of real E2 linked edges sharing that promoter anchor and is a covariate only.

edge_level.definition: One value per real edge/control row within promoter.

derived.rule: Always recomputed from generated base variables; never independently sampled.

linked_edges.definition: The 20,709 E2 candidate linked relations or their Stage-3-supported subset, with stable promoter key.
linked_edges.use: Outcome-blind geometry calibration only. Biological correspondence values forbidden.

matched_controls.definition: Frozen matched-control rows constructed under Stage-3 rules.
matched_controls.use: Control-geometry characterization and sensitivity only; never used as evidence of biological correspondence.

synthetic_candidate_pool.definition: Exactly 24 candidate slots per synthetic promoter, required by the frozen tournament.
synthetic_candidate_pool.construction_rule: Populate candidate-slot covariates from outcome-blind real edge/control geometry conditional on the sampled promoter-level state, but do not equate the number of candidate slots with real promoter_degree.

synthetic_linked_slots.definition: Exactly 4 of the 24 candidate slots selected by the frozen tournament's existing linked-selection preference rule.
synthetic_linked_slots.prohibition: Observed real linked_flag may not directly assign the four synthetic linked slots.

generation.step1: Sample one promoter-level state (promoter_degree, promoter_activity) from the empirical promoter-level calibration with equal promoter weight.
generation.step2: Generate exactly 24 candidate distal slots for that promoter from the edge-level calibration conditional on the sampled promoter-level state. V2 freezes degree-bin conditioning as the primary conditioning variable; any richer conditioning requires a separately frozen successor before execution.
generation.step3: Apply the frozen linked-selection rule unchanged to choose exactly four linked slots.
generation.step4: Recompute all derived features from the generated bases.
generation.sensitivity: Whole-promoter-block bootstrap preserves real promoter blocks as a descriptive sensitivity arm but must be mapped onto the same 24-slot frozen candidate topology without using real linked_flag to choose the four synthetic linked slots.

feasibility_and_exactness.promoter_level: Exact empirical marginal multiset reproduction is required for promoter_degree and promoter_activity when the generated promoter count equals the calibration promoter count; otherwise deterministic rank-reordering with explicit multiplicity receipt is required.
feasibility_and_exactness.edge_level: Exact global marginal reproduction is subordinate to preserving the frozen 24-slot topology and declared conditional hierarchy. The producer must report any incompatibility rather than silently relax either constraint.
feasibility_and_exactness.conditional_model: Per-degree-bin empirical distributions and rank dependence must be reported before and after generation.
feasibility_and_exactness.fail_closed: If the primary construction cannot satisfy the declared topology plus hierarchy checks, emit NO qualification geometry and STOP.

hierarchy_checks: within-promoter variance for each edge-level variable
intraclass correlation for each edge-level variable by promoter
degree-bin conditional edge-level quantiles and rank-correlation matrices
number of generated promoters and exactly 24 candidate slots per promoter
exactly 4 linked slots per promoter after frozen linked-selection
post-construction E.build_features diagnostics on the exact worlds passed to the stress runner

claim_scope.allowed: Realistic promoter/edge structural nuisance geometry under the frozen 24/4 topology.
forbidden: NIH-CARD-like depth-sensitivity geometry until S45 closes
NIH-CARD-like donor/metacell/support/missingness geometry until S46 closes
using observed real linked_flag to assign synthetic linked slots
using biological correspondence to calibrate any distribution
